subject: Consolidated billing ownership and preferred receipt mechanism — portal primary with encrypted email copy
messages:

Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>

Subject: Billing delivery preference for consolidated quarterly invoices + VAT evidence

Hi Hannah / Ben,

Thanks for the onboarding call earlier this week. A quick follow up from NovaCorp AP: we need to decide who will be the invoice originator (your "sender" in our AP system) and how invoices will be delivered for quarterly consolidated billing. Our requirements:

- One consolidated invoice per quarter for each legal entity (we settle on NET30 terms).
- VAT evidence must be attached with the invoice PDF (we need to keep signed proof for reverse-charge where applicable).
- Preferred delivery: portal push (strong preference) but we require an encrypted PDF copy to accounts-payable@novacorp.com for automated reconciliation.
- PO referencing: our ERP requires a PO number on the invoice header.

Can Redwood: 1) act as the invoice publisher (you'll be the originator), 2) push invoices to your portal with a secondary encrypted-email fanout, and 3) include VAT ID lines for reverse-charge on EU-sourced invoices?

I've attached our AP contact sheet (novacorp-ap-contact-sheet.xlsx) with the billing email and person to accept the portal invite. If portal is the path, who on your side will send the invitation and what admin steps must our team complete?

Thanks — Olivia

Olivia Chen
Director, Accounts Payable
NovaCorp Inc.
attachments: novacorp-ap-contact-sheet.xlsx

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@novacorp.com>, accounts-payable@novacorp.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 12:34:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Billing delivery preference for consolidated quarterly invoices + VAT evidence

Hi Olivia —

Appreciate the clear list. We can support the flow you described. High-level options and what we need from NovaCorp to complete setup: 

1) Portal-primary + encrypted-email copy (recommended)
   - Redwood will publish the consolidated invoice as the originator.
   - Portal will emit a push to your AP system and simultaneously send an AES-256 encrypted PDF to accounts-payable@novacorp.com (we'll share the decryption passphrase out-of-band or via your key management).
   - VAT evidence: we attach the signed VAT proof PDF to each invoice; for reverse-charge lines we will include a specific line item and VAT ID tag.

2) Email-only (fallback)
   - If you prefer email only, we can designate a single billing sender address (billing@redwood.com) and send signed PDFs to your AP inbox. This is less robust for webhook/ERP automation.

3) API / webhook integration (advanced)
   - We can push invoice metadata to your webhook endpoint for reconciliation and include a direct PDF link (requires a short-lived signed URL).

Required from NovaCorp to proceed with portal flow:
- Confirm the portal admin (name and email) from the attachment (you already included a contact sheet — thank you).
- Confirm your preferred consolidated cadence: you said quarterly; do you want the invoice date to be the last day of the quarter or a fixed billing day?
- Confirm PO handling: do you want a single PO per quarter or individual PO references on line items?

I've attached: redwood-portal-onboarding-guide.pdf and sample_consolidated_invoice.pdf so you can see how we structure the VAT evidence and PO fields.

Proposed next steps:
- If portal: Connor will send the portal invite and we will schedule a one-hour enrollment call next week to test a push.
- If email-only: Ben will confirm billing sender and provide the signed MPU/authorization form.

Looping in Ben (billing ops) and Connor (AP integrations) who will own the rollout.

Best,

Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-portal-onboarding-guide.pdf; sample_consolidated_invoice.pdf

Thanks Hannah —

Portal-primary sounds good. A few clarifications from our side before we accept the invite: 
- VAT: Our EU branches require reverse-charge notation on the invoice PDF and the supplier VAT (Redwood) in the header. We will provide our VAT IDs per-entity — please embed them in the VAT evidence PDF.
- PO referencing: our preference is to include a primary PO per quarter in the invoice header (we will reference the PO in your invoice metadata).
- Encrypted email copy: please confirm the algorithm and whether we can use our GPG key for the PDF (we prefer using our key over a shared passphrase).

I'll confirm the portal admin in the attached contact sheet (Olivia has that). If you can send a short test invoice to our sandbox AP mailbox (ap-sandbox@novacorp.com) we will validate the ingestion and VAT proof parsing.

Regards,

Peter Landry
VP, Finance Operations
NovaCorp Inc.

Peter / Olivia —

Perfect — thanks for the clarifications. Confirming plan and timeline: 

1) Enroll NovaCorp in Redwood Portal (portal-primary) — Connor will send the admin invite to the contact in your spreadsheet by EOD Mon, Sep 21.

2) Encryption: we support GPG key uploads for encrypted delivery. Please provide the public GPG key for accounts-payable@novacorp.com via a secure channel (or we can accept the key via your KMS thumbprint).

3) VAT & PO: we will include supplier VAT, buyer VAT, and a reverse-charge statement block in the attached VAT evidence PDF. We will place the quarter-level PO in the invoice header per your request.

4) Test push: we will send a test consolidated invoice to ap-sandbox@novacorp.com on Sep 24 (sample_consolidated_invoice.pdf attached). Please validate ingestion and VAT parsing and send feedback.

5) Cutover: target production enrollment and first live quarter invoice on Oct 1 (billing period Q3 close -> invoice date Oct 1). If that works, we will proceed with a full rollout.

Attached: signed_mpu_authorization.pdf (signed MPU form we need returned if you prefer email-only fallback), plus the sample invoice.

If anything changes on PO cadence or you prefer monthly statements instead of quarterly consolidated remits, let us know by Tue Sep 22 so we can adjust the portal grouping logic.

Thanks — looking forward to the test.

Ben Carter
Billing & Collections Lead
Redwood Inference
